On Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 08:20 AM Lucas Chen <lucas.chen@bluehaven.io> wrote:
> We started seeing a sharp drop in throughput at 08:05 PT and a corresponding rise in 500/502 errors hitting our gateway.

Quick initial triage:
- Observed an increase in KV cache misses for the primary model variant serving seq length > 512.
- Autoscaler shows a shortfall in warm workers during a burst; fallback routing to a smaller quantized variant is triggering higher error rates for a subset of requests due to shape mismatch on edge cases.
- No obvious disk or NIC saturations on the host level.

What I'm doing now (in parallel):
1) Pin Bluehaven traffic to the stable variant (redwood-v2-stable) to stop fallback noise.
2) Roll a non-disruptive kernel patch to fix shape-checking that should stop the 502s (if it is indeed the mismatch).
3) Collect and publish a short trace sample to the drive.

Attaching a short latency trace screenshot. Will update in 15.

-Rishi
Senior Software Engineer, Inference
